\documentclass{ximera}
\usepackage{ximera-multiple-choice}

\title{ximera-multiple-choice fixture}
\author{Phase 0}

\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
Fixture for the \texttt{ximera-multiple-choice} spec. Two problems: one exercises basic select-then-check with a wrong-answer retry; the second has four choices with a single correct option to exercise the \texttt{wrong} map. Shuffling is validated by a hand-crafted DOM fixture in the test suite (the current \texttt{ximeraLatex} macros do not expose a per-mc shuffle marker), not by this \texttt{.tex}.
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

\begin{problem}
  Which of these is a prime number?
  \begin{multipleChoice}
    \choice{4}
    \choice{6}
    \choice[correct]{7}
    \choice{9}
  \end{multipleChoice}
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}
  Which of the following is a real number?
  \begin{multipleChoice}
    \choice{The set $\{1, 2, 3\}$}
    \choice[correct]{$\sqrt{2}$}
    \choice{The function $f(x) = x^2$}
    \choice{The empty set}
  \end{multipleChoice}
\end{problem}

\end{document}
